reply_text:
Reviewed `phone-normalize` at `173e408` against `main`. **One issue to fix before merging:**

**[P1] Only the first space is removed — `src/normalize.js:4`**
`raw.trim().replace(' ', '')` removes just one space, leaving subsequent spaces to fail E.164 validation. All three examples advertised in the README currently throw `bad number` instead of queueing:
- `+44 20 7946 0958`
- `0044 20 7946 0958`
- `+1 (415) 555-0100`

Remove spaces globally and add end-to-end `queueText` tests for these examples. The existing normalization test contains only one space, so it misses the bug.

**Validation:** All 5 existing tests pass; I reproduced the failures above separately. No code changes; working tree remains clean.
